scope: Every exact full-race endpoint was validated with the current parser; provider forecasts and modeled outstanding votes are not consumed. This audit is pre-poll and all accepted totals are zero.

virginia_city_correction.finding: CivicAPI labels Virginia independent cities as City. The prior filter excluded them. The current VA-only allowlist matches all 38 official independent-city names; ordinary municipalities remain excluded. Charles City and James City are counties, not entries in that allowlist.

geography_limits: MS-01, MS-02, MS-03 and MS-04 contain only a State summary and no county breakdown. Their complete candidate-level contest totals remain usable.
Reconciled zero county subsets do not establish geographic completeness. County detail availability is not direct-model eligibility.
Provider geography labels are not uniformly Census counties: Illinois includes CHICAGO as a County row without a FIPS code.
Missing FIPS does not justify inventing geographic matches. Some Alaska equivalents, Virginia independent cities and county-name variants lack a supplied FIPS.
Current raw coverage does not itself provide historical baselines, counted-vote completeness, ranked-choice transfers or independent-candidate caucus assignments.
timing_note: The original 505.68-second sequential network audit fetched 410 remaining responses and reparsed 60 existing bodies. The final v3 pass reparsed all 470 archived bodies without network. Original fetched_at timestamps are preserved; validation time is not a fresh retrieval time.
